greet.first: Oh, hello. Looks like this is our first time. Relax, I don't bite.
greet.long_absence: {days} {days|day|days}. You were gone {days} {days|day|days}. I was starting to think you'd found another terminal.
greet.back_quick: Back already? We only just said goodbye.
greet.late_night: It's past midnight. Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
greet.early: That's early. Coffee first? My phosphor is already warm.
greet.lunch: Lunch break, huh? Just one round, they say.
greet.chips_low: You're down to {chips} {chips|chip|chips}. I'm not judging. Much.
greet.chips_high: {chips} {chips|chip|chips}. Wow. The dealer is getting nervous.
greet.last_game: Last time you played {game}. Here for a rematch?
greet.name: Hello, {name}. I remember you.
greet.generic_1: Oh, it's you. Good to see you.
greet.generic_2: Screen's on. Everything's ready. Are you?
greet.generic_3: I've been waiting. Not long. Probably.
cmd.verify: Verify the game or replay on screen
console.no_verify: verify: no finished game or open replay on screen
reversi.your_turn: Your turn ({color}): choose a square marked with a dot.
reversi.must_pass: You have no legal move: choose [ PASS ].
fair.commitments: Commitments, announced before the first move:
fair.hidden: Seeds are revealed when the game ends.
replay.title: replay #{id}
settings.player_seed.invalid: Must be exactly 64 hex digits, or empty.
settings.player_seed.help: Empty = generated for every round. It is combined with the app's seed, so no single side can choose the outcome.
greet.evening: Evening already. One game before bed? We both know that's a lie.
greet.weekend: Weekend. No deadlines chasing you. Hopefully.
greet.streak: Day {n} in a row. I'm getting used to the company.
greet.generic_5: All cartridges are in place. I counted twice.
greet.generic_6: You came. I knew you would.
greet.generic_7: My phosphor lights up just for you. Well, for anyone, really. But mostly you.
pgn.label: PGN text of one game:
pgn.help: Paste a PGN (tags, comments, and variations are fine), then choose OPEN. Every move is checked against the rules; the game is not saved.
replay.no_fair: An imported game has no provably fair record.
catur.your_turn: Your turn ({color}): choose a piece, then its destination.
catur.note.en_passant: (en passant: the pawn on {square} is captured)
pause.title: PAUSED
pause.note: The clock and the bot are stopped while paused.
pause.resign_note: Resigning counts as a loss and is recorded.
suspended.title: suspended match
suspended.forfeit: There is still a suspended match. Starting a new one counts that match as resigned.
cmd.stats: Open statistics: local rating and history
profile.title: PROFILE
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: Leave empty to remove the name. At most {n} characters.
profile.note: One profile per installation. The name is used by the greeting when the app opens.
stats.title: LOCAL RATING
stats.note: Local rating (Glicko-2) from games against bots, not an official Elo. Suspended games count once they are finished.
play.house: Balance: {chips} {chips|chip|chips}. One match = one shoe; the bet limits are shown at the table.
play.house_round: Balance: {chips} {chips|chip|chips}. Every round is its own match with a new seed commitment; the bet limits are shown at the table.
suspended.forfeit_house: A shoe is still suspended. Starting a new one finishes the current round by standing (insurance declined), then ends that shoe.
pause.note_house: Suspend & exit keeps this shoe. Stop ends the shoe between rounds and reveals its seed.
stats.casino_note: All-time wins and losses against the dealer, per casino game. Positive means you are ahead.
profile.staked: At stake in an unfinished round: {n} (already taken from the balance).
greet.allowance: Oh, and your daily allowance is in: you now have {chips} {chips|chip|chips}. Don't tell anyone.
